description_en: You can call DescribeResolverEndpoint to retrieve the details of an endpoint by its ID
description_zh: 调用DescribeResolverEndpoint根据终端节点ID获取终端节点详情
name: DescribeResolverEndpoint

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_zh: 终端节点ID，终端节点的唯一标识
parameters.name: endpoint_id

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the endpoint was created

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The time when the endpoint was created. This is a UNIX timestamp

Id.description_zh: 终端节点ID，终端节点的唯一标识

IpConfigs.description_en: A list of IP address configurations for the outbound traffic source

items.description_en: The IP address configuration for the outbound traffic source

AzId.description_en: The ID of the zone where the vSwitch is located

CidrBlock.description_en: The IPv4 CIDR block of the vSwitch
CidrBlock.description_zh: 子网掩码，交换机的IPv4网段

Ip.description_en: An IP address within the specified CIDR block. If you leave this parameter empty, the system automatically assigns an IP address
Ip.description_zh: 子网掩码参数范围内的IP地址（留空则系统自动分配）

SecurityGroupId.description_en: The ID of the security group. The rules in the security group are applied to the outbound VPC
SecurityGroupId.description_zh: 安全组ID，安全组里面的规则将应用于出站VPC

Status.description_en:
The status of the endpoint. Valid values:

SUCCESS: The endpoint works as expected.

INIT: The endpoint is being created.

FAILED: The endpoint failed to be created.

CHANGE_INIT: The endpoint is being modified.

CHANGE_FAILED: The endpoint failed to be modified.

EXCEPTION: An exception occurred on the endpoint
Status.description_zh:
终端节点状态。描述：

SUCCESS: 工作正常。
INIT：创建中。
FAILED：创建失败。
CHANGE_INIT: 修改中。
CHANGE_FAILED: 修改失败。
EXCEPTION: 工作异常

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the endpoint was last updated

UpdateTimestamp.description_en: The time when the endpoint was last updated. This is a UNIX timestamp

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the outbound virtual private cloud (VPC). All outbound DNS query traffic from the Resolver is forwarded through this VPC
VpcId.description_zh: 出站专有网络ID（VPC ID），解析器所有出站的DNS查询流量都将经由此VPC进行流量转发

VpcName.description_en: The name of the outbound VPC

VpcRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the outbound VPC is located

VpcRegionName.description_en: The name of the region where the outbound VPC is located
